## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(parallel)
library(broom)
library(broom.helpers)

```

## READ IN DATA

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Load complete analytic dataset (HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset) from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd file
complete_subset <- readRDS("NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset20261601.RDS")
dim(complete_subset)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

## DEFINE MODEL EXPOSURES, OUTCOMES, AND COVARIATES

```{r}

## Unadjusted
  ## Define variables
exposure_vars <- c("childrural_democoggen", "SCHLYRS_rev", "LIVEGPAR_R", "CHSMOKE_R")
outcome_vars <- c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")
outcome_vars_gm <- c("globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean")


## Adjusted
  ## Define individual exposures corresponding to the covariates below
exposure_vars1 <- c("childrural_democoggen")
exposure_vars2 <- c("SCHLYRS_rev")
exposure_vars3 <- c("LIVEGPAR_R")
exposure_vars4 <- c("CHSMOKE_R")


  ## Define model covariates for Primary models
covars_childrural <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "BEALE_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "smoke_latest", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  
covars_schlyrs <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "Parent_Educ", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "smoke_latest", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  
covars_livegpar <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "ATOTB_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "smoke_latest", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  
covars_chsmk <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "smoke_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "ds_latest", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  

```

## UNADJUSTED LINEAR REGRESSION

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Create combinations of all possible outcome and exposure relationships
var_combinations <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars)

## Run the unadjusted models
unadjusted_m1 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations, complete_subset)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(unadjusted_m1, file = "Model_Diagnostics/unadjusted_primaryexposures20261501.RDS")

## Summarize models
unadjusted_m1_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations, unadjusted_m1)

## Export the combined data frame to a CSV file
writexl::write_xlsx(unadjusted_m1_summaries_df, "Output/FullyAdjusted/Unadjusted_MODEL3AA_Summary20261501.xlsx")

```

### Global Methylation

```{r}

## Create combinations of all possible outcome and exposure relationships
var_combinations_gm <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars_gm)

## Run the unadjusted models
unadjusted_m2 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_gm, complete_subset)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(unadjusted_m2, file = "Model_Diagnostics/unadjusted_primaryexposuresGM20261501.RDS")

## Summarize models
unadjusted_m2_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations_gm, unadjusted_m2)

## Export the data frame 
writexl::write_xlsx(unadjusted_m2_summaries_df, "Output/FullyAdjusted/Unadjusted_GLOBALMODEL3_Summary20261501.xlsx")

```

## Primary LINEAR REGRESSION

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Grew up in a rural area
  ## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_mrural <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars1, outcome_vars)

  ## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_mrural <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_mrural, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_childrural)
adjusted_mrural_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations_mrural, adjusted_mrural)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_mrural, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_m3rural20261501.RDS")

  ## Export the data frame 
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mrural_summaries_df, "Output/FullyAdjusted/ChildRural_M3_AA_Summary20261501.xlsx")



## Years spent in school
  ## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_mschlyrs <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars2, outcome_vars)

  ## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_mschlyrs <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_mschlyrs, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_schlyrs)
adjusted_mschlyrs_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations_mschlyrs, adjusted_mschlyrs)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_mschlyrs, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_m3schlyrs20261501.RDS")

  ## Export the data frame 
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mschlyrs_summaries_df, "Output/FullyAdjusted/SCHLYRS_M3_AA_Summary20261501.xlsx")



## Live with a grandparent
  ## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_mlivegpar <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars3, outcome_vars)

  ## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_mlivegpar <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_mlivegpar, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_livegpar)
adjusted_mlivegpar_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations_mlivegpar, adjusted_mlivegpar)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_mlivegpar, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_m3livegpar20261501.RDS")

  ## Export the data frame 
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mlivegpar_summaries_df, "Output/FullyAdjusted/LIVEGPAR_M3_AA_Summary20261501.xlsx")



## Smoking during childhood
  ## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_mchsmk <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars4, outcome_vars)

  ## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_mchsmk <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_mchsmk, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_chsmk)
adjusted_mchsmk_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations_mchsmk, adjusted_mchsmk)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_mchsmk, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_m3chsmk20261501.RDS")

  ## Export the data frame 
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mchsmk_summaries_df, "Output/FullyAdjusted/CHSMK_M3_AA_Summary20261501.xlsx")

```

## EXPORT RESULTS

```{r}

## write results to single files
sheets_primaryAdj = list('unadj age accel' = unadjusted_m1_summaries_df, 'unadj global' = unadjusted_m2_summaries_df, 'childrural(primary adj AA)' = adjusted_mrural_summaries_df, 'childrural(primary adj GM)' = adjusted_gmrural_summaries_df, 'SCHLYRS(primary adj AA)' = adjusted_mschlyrs_summaries_df, 'SCHLYRS(primary adj GM)' = adjusted_gmschlyrs_summaries_df, 'LIVEGPAR(primary adj AA)' = adjusted_mlivegpar_summaries_df, 'LIVEGPAR(primary adj GM)' = adjusted_gmlivegpar_summaries_df, 'CHSMOKE(primary adj AA)' = adjusted_mchsmk_summaries_df, 'CHSMOKE(primary adj GM)' = adjusted_gmchsmk_summaries_df)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets_primaryAdj, 'Output/FullyAdjusted/2026Jan15_primarym3_regression.xlsx')
```
